name: OX500 / MACHINE ACTIVITY
basis: A build-time snapshot of versioned public decisions and canonical works, not live AI consciousness or a complete run history.
limitations: Publication dates are not execution timestamps.
Some decisions only record the month.
Unselected and pending candidate text is never published.
Private workflow run details and visitor questions are not included.
Accepted external origin labels are unverified; the archive does not prove agent identities.
